value.dataset_scope: BreaKHis only; multiclass arrangement is not independent data
value.input_resolution: Working 224x224 derivative; measure actual dimensions in audit
value.provenance_boundary: Unknown original transform/backup lineage remains an explicit restriction

topics.rationale: Bound the sprint to the available binary derivative; its label arrangements are not independent replication.

value.rule: Full YEAR-SLIDE_ID with suffix; cross-magnification components
value.exact_duplicates: Link raw/RGB hashes before partitions; retain deterministic representatives
value.exposure: Exposed components development-only; unknown history not untouched

topics.rationale: Avoid identity/content leakage while preserving suffixes and honest filename-group terminology.

value.primary: Mean malignant probability within magnification, then equal mean over available magnifications
value.missing_magnifications: Available-only mean; no imputation; report support and denominators

topics.rationale: Avoid implicit magnification weights from unequal image counts; test image-weighted pooling secondarily.

value.training: RTX 5070 Ti; CPU correctness checks supported
value.primary_timing: CPU batch-one median resident forward latency
value.secondary_timing: RTX 5070 Ti; synchronized independent timing protocol

topics.rationale: Optimize the stated CPU deployment objective; use GPU training and separately measured GPU inference.

value.compact: Proposed MobileNetV3-small dense comparator; not implemented yet
value.surgery: VGG channel surgery first; dependency-aware ResNet/MobileNet surgery out of minimum scope

topics.rationale: Use the implemented VGG surgery first and control for compact dense alternatives within measured compute.

value.inner_roles: Group-separated training and development selection within each outer fold
value.calibration_role: Distinct development calibration role; exact support compromise pending
value.exposure_constraints: Only reviewed candidate components may enter untouched design; no outer-test feedback

topics.rationale: Separate development choices from held-out evaluation; actual independent-group support governs fold feasibility.
Keep partition, fitting, pruning and search randomness attributable rather than relying on one implicit global seed.

value.epoch: Development-only checkpoint criterion; exact rule pending
value.candidate: Same sensitivity/specificity constraints for B/C/D/E; no outer-test selection
value.threshold: Argmax/0.5 reference plus separate development-calibrated operating point
value.calibration_data: Development labels only; never outer test

topics.rationale: Separate checkpoint/candidate choice from threshold calibration and give competing methods equal development access.

value.absolute_performance: Report absolute sensitivity/specificity with support and uncertainty
value.clinical_noninferiority: No clinical/noninferiority claim without justified margins and power

topics.rationale: A sensitivity gain may trade away specificity; numerical tolerances require justification before scientific use.

value.matched_costs: Equal data, threshold opportunity and adaptation/recovery/search accounting across methods

topics.rationale: Unmatched search or recovery can explain an apparent method advantage; measure and equalize costs.

value.cost_estimation: Measure epoch/search/recovery and timing-session costs before scaling
value.stop_rule: Reduce folds/seeds/architectures or retain a disclosed pilot if remaining compute cannot fit 7-9 days

topics.rationale: The 7-9 day scope requires measured compute estimates and an honest reduced-pilot route.

value.O1: Test whether malignant filename groups show concentrated reproducible pruning damage
value.O2: Test incremental group-vulnerability benefit beyond constrained selection and malignant weighting
value.O3: Test architecture/device robustness within BreaKHis; independent-data generalization deferred

topics.rationale: Test concentrated damage and incremental benefit as falsifiable hypotheses without assuming novelty.

value.A: Conventional magnitude channel pruning; ordinary development selection
value.B: Same pruning as A; sensitivity/specificity-constrained selection
value.C: Malignant weighting with the same selection constraints as B
value.D: Proposed group-balanced vulnerable-case mechanism with B constraints
value.E: Strongest feasible established adaptive/class-aware method with B constraints
value.negative_route: If D does not repeatably exceed B/C/E, revise mechanism or report empirical/negative findings

topics.rationale: Separate ranking/allocation gains from constrained selection, class weighting and standard compact-model effects.

value.unit: One filename group; propagate exact-duplicate components in resampling/design
value.uncertainty: Paired group uncertainty; exact bootstrap support policy pending
value.fold_seed_reporting: Report folds/seeds separately; repeated fits do not create independent groups
value.multiplicity: Small prespecified primary comparison set; wider subgroup work exploratory

topics.rationale: Groups are sampling units; repeated seeds/folds do not manufacture independent clinical evidence.

value.primary: Group malignant sensitivity with specificity safeguard and CPU batch-one median forward latency
value.secondary: Specificity, balanced accuracy, image-weighted aggregation, size/MACs, GPU timing
value.missing_support: Report class/magnification/subtype denominators and unsupported estimates
value.timing_sessions: Separate repeated sessions; resident forward and end-to-end timing regions declared separately

topics.rationale: Jointly report detection and efficiency with specificity, support and timing-region definitions.

value.clinical: No clinical safety or verified-patient claim
value.novelty: Unverified; closest-method overlap must be adjudicated
value.generalization: BreaKHis derivative scope; no independent-dataset generalization claim
value.confirmatory_freeze: M6 only, after held-out protocol/code/selection/threshold freeze

topics.rationale: Keep claims within completed evidence and defer confirmatory freeze and independent-data generalization.

value.normalization: Record training-only fitted transforms and version
value.augmentation: Training only; no test augmentation or test-informed recipe tuning

topics.rationale: Initialization and fitted transforms affect fairness and leakage; the exact shared recipe must be attributable.
